jobs.description:
Securitas Security Services USA, Inc. in Bolingbrook, IL is seeking a Warehouse Security Officer for a full-time role. The position offers an hourly wage of $18.71 and requires strong observation, communication, and customer service skills to manage access control and patrol duties.

The role emphasizes teamwork, incident reporting, and the ability to handle various weather conditions while maintaining safety and security across the site. Benefits and pre-employment screening are included.

jobs.description:

Responsibilities include monitoring surveillance, inspecting personnel on entry/exit, managing badge systems, and performing risk assessments and safety walks in warehouse zones. Prior asset protection and alarm system experience is preferred.
